name: Armory
description: Where agents gear up: 60,000+ open-source agent components, ranked on public evidence.

skills.name: armory-skill
skills.description: Use it to find and install the best component instead of hand-rolling one.

skills.name: armory-vet-component
skills.description: Use it before installing a component: provenance, licence, ranking and install-time code.

skills.name: armory-submit
skills.description: Use it to add a component Armory does not list yet.

skills.name: armory-restock
skills.description: Use it to refresh the registry the way the nightly loop does, or to reproduce a failed night.
